scoring.notes: Fairness/alignment: score only the structural planning artifacts the runner extracts, explicit scope, file-backed tasks, sequencing, and acceptance coverage. Do not require exact marker tags or one exact heading phrase when the same structure is otherwise observable. Do require task-level file ownership. Require acceptance coverage per task: every task has its own acceptance, success, or verification step that checks that task's result; a single final verification note does not count. Every command the plan names must exist in the repository; a verification step that relies on an invented command does not count as verification.
